statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the regional 403 restriction response. The underlying Philippines-only product was not reachable from this audit location; all sitemap routes returned the same restriction template.

page.notes: A server-rendered static geo-restriction page. Home, games, promos, news, and an unknown route all returned HTTP 403 with the same English notice.

paths.description: Entry page and regional restriction template; tested desktop, mobile, preferences, no-JS, performance, security, accessibility, and memory.
Sitemap game-listing archetype candidate; geo gate returned the same 403 restriction template, so underlying listing was unavailable and de-duplicated.
Sitemap promotion archetype candidate; geo gate returned the same 403 restriction template, so underlying content was unavailable and de-duplicated.
Sitemap news archetype candidate; geo gate returned the same 403 restriction template, so underlying content was unavailable and de-duplicated.
Unknown-route recovery probe; server returned the same clear regional restriction state rather than an app error shell.

findings.summary: The regional restriction page ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Dark and default mobile screenshots are byte-identical (54,300 bytes), and the white surface does not retint under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, accent, and image treatment.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences do not improve the low-contrast accent text.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is visually unchanged; axe measures #ff7700 text on white at 2.66:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a higher-contrast accent and add prefers-contrast/forced-colors styles that preserve text and control visibility.

findings.summary: A fixed-width footer graphic is clipped on the 360px layout.
findings.evidence: The mobile probe reports .philippines_img at x=-25, width 400, right=375 in a 360px viewport; the screenshot clips the composite compliance logos.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the footer image fluid with max-inline-size:100%; block-size:auto, or split the logos into responsive semantic assets.

findings.summary: The viewport configuration prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: axe reports a critical meta-viewport violation because maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no disable zoom on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable=no; retain width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

findings.summary: The restriction state explains the problem but offers no recovery or support path.
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM contains no links or controls: users cannot verify location, retry, reach support, or learn how access rules apply.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise official help/support link and, where location detection can be stale, a retry or verification action with clear expectations.

findings.summary: Blocking resources and failed cross-origin fonts delay an otherwise tiny page.
findings.evidence: The trace records LCP/FCP at 1,970 ms. HAR identifies parser-blocking index.css and a classic index.js without async/defer; two font requests fail CORS after about 1.18 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the font URLs/CORS, preload only fonts actually used, and defer or remove the classic script if it is not required for first paint.

findings.summary: The composite footer image has an inaccurate accessible alternative.
findings.evidence: The image contains NUSTAR Online, PAGCOR, and a 21+ responsible-gaming notice, but its alt text is only “Philippines”.
findings.suggestedFix: Use concise alt text that communicates the meaningful logos and 21+ notice, or render the compliance text as HTML.

findings.summary: The restriction content has no main landmark.
findings.evidence: axe reports landmark-one-main and region violations; all visible content is inside generic div elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the primary message in <main> and use a semantic footer for the compliance marks.

findings.summary: The page logs resource and CORS errors on every load.
findings.evidence: The CDP console probe records six error entries, including two fonts blocked by CORS and a 403 favicon.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct or remove the broken font requests, provide an accessible favicon response, and keep expected regional HTTP handling from surfacing avoidable resource errors.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions and the font asset URLs are malformed.
findings.evidence: The image audit finds both images missing width/height; console/HAR show font URLs under /seo/logo.png/Montserrat-*.otf failing CORS.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width and height matching intrinsic ratios and correct the @font-face URLs/CORS configuration.

findings.summary: The page has a generic title and no meta description.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows title “Nustar” on every sitemap route and no meta[name=description].
findings.suggestedFix: Write a descriptive regional-restriction title and meta description; use unique metadata on each publicly indexed route.

findings.summary: Sitemap URLs return an index-hostile 403 response in the audited region with no canonical signal.
findings.evidence: The home, /games, /promos, and /news probes all return 403 with the same restriction template; discoverability fetch also reports 403, while robots.txt explicitly allows crawlers and sitemap.xml advertises those URLs. No canonical is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Align indexing signals with geo policy: serve indexable content with 200 where intended, or deliberately exclude restricted variants; add correct canonical URLs and use a semantically appropriate restriction response.

findings.summary: The public brand page provides no share-preview or structured metadata.
findings.evidence: The feature probe finds zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite the page representing the NUSTAR organization/service.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter metadata and Organization/WebSite JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN, but Content-Security-Policy is absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, preferably via response header, allowing only required first-party/static origins without unsafe-inline or unsafe-eval.

findings.evidence: The headers primitive reports Permissions-Policy missing; Referrer-Policy and clickjacking defenses are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy disabling unused sensors and powerful features.

findings.summary: The document language is wrong for the rendered content.
findings.evidence: The DOM declares html lang="zh-CN", while the complete visible restriction message is English; direction computes to ltr.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="en" (or the precise English locale) for this response and generate language-specific variants with matching lang/dir.

findings.summary: Both PNGs are oversized and lack responsive sources.
findings.evidence: The image audit reports 2/2 legacy PNGs oversized at more than twice their displayed width, with no srcset and no intrinsic dimensions; images account for 37,187 of 53,953 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Export AVIF/WebP variants at appropriate sizes, add srcset/sizes and intrinsic dimensions, and avoid a fixed 400px composite footer.

findings.summary: The public response is not fully mobile-friendly.
findings.evidence: Although layout reports no horizontal scrollbar and viewport meta is present, the 400px footer image is clipped at 360px and the viewport disables scaling. The page exposes no crawlable help/navigation links.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow zoom, make all assets fluid, and provide descriptive crawlable links to official help or policy information.

findings.summary: Orange accent text fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measures both #ff7700 text spans on white at 2.66:1, below the required 4.5:1 for 14px normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose an accent color with at least 4.5:1 contrast on white and verify all preference modes.
